title: ProposalDecision
description: Client -> engine. The engineer accepts or rejects a proposal. Accept is a compare-and-swap: the readSet the client saw must still equal the twin, otherwise the engine answers STALE_VERSION and the client re-requests.

reason.description: Free text on reject; feeds the ML model's training set as a negative example.

appliedElementIds.description: On accept: the new Duct / fitting element ids the plugin created, so the twin can map the proposal to real elements.
